coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch, not the primary nationwide collector; production Food Line collection remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches (eight fast, four slow) completed. No newly reported, verifiable, U.S.-located event in the specified observation window met the inclusion criteria. Negative result does not establish no disruptions occurred.

Results included historical sole-grocery losses (e.g. September 11, 2026 Shur Fine Food Mart fire in Spencer, NY), which precede this hour: https://www.wbng.com/2026/09/11/shur-fine-food-mart-burns-after-afternoon-fire-spencer/

Historical abrupt pantry closure (Ruby's Pantry on April 1, 2026) was excluded as prior-window: https://www.mprnews.org/story/2026/04/01/rubys-pantry-abruptly-closes-37-minnesota-upper-midwest-food-shelf-sites
Oct. 26 New York food-bank funding grant report concerns expansion, not loss or interruption and was excluded: https://www.timesunion.com/news/article/hochul-food-banks-funding-snap-22493570.php

SNAP/WIC search results largely referred to the October/November 2025 shutdown, not new 2026 agency-confirmed benefits interruption. A purported October 2026 SNAP page mixed 2025 publication dates and lacked timely official corroboration; excluded.
Earlier unverified Facebook flood-related pantry cancellation remains without established date, U.S. provider or location. No new independently verifying result surfaced; not promoted to a finding.
Search indexing can lag same-hour local agency/provider notices. Search results were filtered for event publication date, U.S. jurisdiction, immediate access consequences and duplicates.
No approvals, publication, schedule or task changes, disabling, or modification of production collection.
